summary: Tenaris S.A. filed a 6-K reporting shareholder approval at an Extraordinary General Meeting to cancel 62,355,174 treasury shares acquired via the third buyback program (June 2025–March 2026). The cancellation reduces issued share capital from US$1,071,994,930 to US$1,009,639,756, with each share of US$1.00 par value. This capital reduction is a direct return of capital to shareholders, shrinking equity by approximately 5.8%. The board recommended and shareholders approved the cancellation and corresponding amendment to article 5 of the articles of association. The filing is routine post-meeting reporting; no advisors named. What to watch: the reduction may signal ongoing commitment to returning excess cash, but no trading catalyst remains.
